_comment: Frozen Vuetify fixed-palette colour names (color="grey-lighten-5", class="bg-white", …) in templates and script defaults. stylelint cannot see these — it parses CSS, not <template>. The ratchet in .claude/scripts/check-repo-rules.sh blocks any NEW one; these are pre-existing and may only go down. Regenerate with `bash .claude/scripts/check-repo-rules.sh --update-palette-baseline`. See docs/design-system.md.
